literal: The faults that entered into the dignity of one's family will perish when a person dispels the dominance of laziness.
translation: The blemishes that have crept into the dignity of a person's family will vanish the moment they overcome the dominance of laziness.
modern: ஒருவன் தன் சோம்பேறித்தனத்தின் ஆதிக்கத்தை ஒழித்தால், அவனுடைய குடும்பப் பெருமையில் வந்து சேர்ந்துள்ள குற்றங்கள் நீங்கிவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how laziness ruins family status and how overcoming it restores honor. The word 'குடியாண்மை' refers to the dignity, leadership, or governance of one's family line, which can be stained by faults ('குற்றம்') over time. The poet uses 'மடியாண்மை' (the rule or dominance of laziness) to describe how sloth can take complete control of a person. When a person actively dispels ('மாற்ற') this dominance of laziness, all the accumulated blemishes and decline in their family's status will completely disappear ('கெடும்').
